annotation.bound_parties_text: The Law imposes obligations on Operators (including owners) of Autonomous Vehicles, Agents (exclusive distributors), Passengers, and the RTA and concerned Government Entities, which must cooperate with the RTA.
annotation.dates_quote: This Law will be published in the Official Gazette and will come into force ninety (90) days after the date of its publication.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
